title: Multi-perspective observation
opening: From the player-side view, a shot can look unreachable. The wider view of that same point shows where the player started beside the shot's path, so you can compare the two before judging the play.

views.label: Player-side view
views.description: This view stays near the player's side of the court, where the shot can look unreachable.

views.label: Wider court view
views.description: This wider view keeps the same point and shows the player's starting position beside the shot path.

labels.view: Choose a view of the same point
labels.ownPursuit: Reflect on what each view shows
labels.prediction: Before you switch views, what do you expect the wider view to reveal?
labels.observation: What does the wider view make easier to see about the player's position and the shot?
labels.revision: What can you say about the point now, and what remains unknown from these views?
